card.name: The letters GD inside abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letters "GD" (or the D after G) when they start a longer abbreviation such as GDH-PQQ or anti-GD2. It also fires on a few odd name pieces after G.

modes.label: GDH glucose test names
modes.description: "GD" opening GDH-PQQ, GDH-FAD or GDH-NAD, the glucose dehydrogenase methods in blood glucose monitor warnings.
modes.example: do not use blood glucose monitoring devices using glucose dehydrogenase pyrroloquinolinequinone (<<GD>>H-PQQ)-, glucose-dye

modes.label: Anti-GD2 antibody
modes.description: The D in GD2 after "anti-G" in antibody study text.
modes.example: In a study of a related anti-G<<D>>2 antibody conducted in 12 adult

modes.label: Names split after G
modes.description: A piece of a proper name or place name after an initial G.
